dial.summary: BTC recovered above $60K in post-Thanksgiving Black Friday trading with perp funding at just 0.0038%, confirming the low-leverage accumulation structure as TOTAL market cap rebounded to $2.13T; DXY at 103.68 and TIPS real yields at 2.79% remain macro headwinds, but rising Global M2 at $104.2T with BTC.D firm at 57–59% sustains the BTC Accumulation case ahead of the Dec 1 ISM print and the Dec 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $104,174B ($104.2T) as of November 25, 2026 (metricsmonster.com tracker); 4-week trend UP — from ~$103.9T on Oct 27 to $104.2T on Nov 25 (+$0.3T); US M2 component ~$23.5T (+6.5% YoY); no YoY contraction signal; status supportive (4-week trend up); next US M2 release December 22, 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2, above consensus 54.6%), up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); Production sub-index 59.0 (highest since Nov 2021), New Orders 55.5, Employment 52.4; status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); November 2026 data scheduled December 1, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET; consensus ~55.0 (Trading Economics, Economy.com).

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 103.68 on November 27, 2026 (DealPlexus 103.68, Trading Economics 103.651, WellsTrack 103.68; day range 103.64–103.86); DXY eased slightly from 103.83 (Nov 26 settlement) in Black Friday shortened session; 4-week trend UP — Oct 27 close 102.32 (Investing.com, Yahoo Finance) vs Nov 27 103.68 = +1.36pts (+1.33%), above 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (ICE DXY 103.68 above 100 threshold); 52-week range 95.55–104.53.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.79% as of November 24, 2026 (macrotrends, StreetStats, multiple independent sources confirmed); Nov 25 PCE release (core 3.3% YoY) may have caused a brief intraday dip; 4-week trend UP — Oct 27 close 2.64% (portfolio-terminal.com, treasuryratewatch.com) vs Nov 24 2.79% = +15bps, above 5bps flat threshold; status headwind (rising trend and above 2%); FRED API not accessible this session — values cross-verified from macrotrends and StreetStats.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread ~21bps as of November 25–27, 2026 (DWK Alpha Nov 27 morning note: 2yr 4.650%, 10yr 4.864% = +21.4bps; market recap: 4.61%/4.85% = +24bps; U.S. cash markets closed Nov 26 Thanksgiving); 4-week comparison: Oct 27 close 10yr 4.993%, 2yr 4.70% = +29.3bps (247wallst, portfolio-terminal) vs current +21bps = DOWN (flattened ~8bps); curve remains positive, well above -50bps headwind threshold; status neutral (positive but not steepening).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 (Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Nov 4: $6,748,145M; Oct 21: $6,753,604M); Nov 27 H.4.1 release (covering Nov 25 balance) published today but federalreserve.gov not accessible from this cloud session — Nov 18 figure used as latest confirmed; 4-week comparison: Oct 27 est. ~$6.76T → Nov 18 $6.741T = -$19B = -0.28%, within flat threshold; status supportive (QT effectively paused, balance sheet stable).

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC perpetual OI-weighted funding rate at 0.0038% per 8h as of November 27, 2026 (CoinGlass main BTC page: 0.0038%, ~4.2% annualized; CoinGlass futures page: 0.0054%); 30-day trend FLAT — consistently in the 0.001–0.005% range throughout November, confirming low-leverage positioning at $60K recovery; Au79 Macro (Nov 25): +0.0048% OI-weighted; status supportive (0.0038% far below 0.04% headwind threshold).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$289B in November 2026 (down from May peak $309.7B per CryptoBriefing); total crypto market cap ~$2.13T (Analytics Insight Nov 25: $2.13T, BTC dominance 55.9%; CryptoNews Nov 26: $2.15T, BTC above $60K; Gate.com BTC dominance 58.91%); derived dominance $289B/$2.13T ≈ 13.6%; 30-day trend UP — Oct 27 TOTAL ~$2.6T with stablecoin cap ~$295-300B ≈ 11.5% vs current 13.6%; status neutral (stablecoin dominance rising but total market cap declining — headwind requires BOTH rising simultaneously, not met); TOTAL recovering with BTC reclaiming $60K.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET (first business day of December); October reading was 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month, above consensus 54.6%); consensus for November is ~55.1; a continuation above 55 reinforces the late-cycle expansion narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; Prices Paid sub-index closely watched given elevated input cost pressures in October.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 JOLTS at 10:00 AM ET; a print above 8M openings would reinforce the tight labor market narrative supporting the December 9 rate decision; the quits rate is a leading indicator of wage growth; released 3 days before the November NFP (December 4).

upcoming.title: ADP Private Employment (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ADP releases November 2026 National Employment Report at 8:15 AM ET; private sector payroll estimate published 2 days before the official BLS NFP (December 4); a print above 200K would align with the strong labor market narrative ahead of the December 9 FOMC decision.

upcoming.title: ISM Services PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Non-Manufacturing (Services) PMI at 10:00 AM ET; services sector activity closely watched given the Fed's focus on services inflation; a reading above 55 would reinforce the tight labor/services backdrop heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; released one day before November NFP.

upcoming.title: NFP (November 2026 Jobs Report)
upcoming.note: BLS releases November 2026 Non-Farm Payrolls at 8:30 AM ET (first Friday of December); last major labor market print before the December 9 FOMC decision; a print above 200K alongside low unemployment would reinforce the rate action case; average hourly earnings closely watched for second-round inflation signals.
